text:
Zara: Quick note - while validating the Optimize guide I hit a dead anchor on /guides/optimize/cache-config#ttl and the caching diagram 403s. Repro in staging. Please triage.
Ben: Which anchor exactly? Can you paste the URL?
Zara: https://kb.redwood.ai/guides/optimize/cache-config#ttl -> 404. Diagram: /assets/diagrams/cache-lifecycle.svg -> 403. I also saw a console warning about CDN shortlink mismatch.
docs-bot: link-scan: 1 dead anchor and 1 asset 403 detected for /guides/optimize/cache-config (scan: ls-2026-03-23-09). anchor: #ttl (404). asset: /assets/diagrams/cache-lifecycle.svg -> 403.
Ivy: Assigning to @Ben (page owner). Ben, recommended triage: check last PR touching this doc, verify header text->anchor mapping, and confirm asset path in repo vs CDN mapping.
Ben: On it. Running local linkcheck and grepping git log.
(10m) Ben: Found last PR changed heading from "Time-to-live (TTL)" to "TTL (time-to-live)" which altered auto-generated anchor. Also image path in markdown still references /diagrams/ rather than /assets/diagrams. Quick fix: add explicit id to header and update image path. Will open micro-PR.
Zara: Customer impact: small - internal QA couldn't find TTL section. Not blocking production but prefer quick PR.
Ben: Plan: 1) add explicit header id: "## TTL (time-to-live) {#ttl}", 2) update image src to /assets/diagrams/cache-lifecycle.svg, 3) add linkcheck unit to the doc's CI. Will open PR and request fast review.
(25m later) Ben: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4377 - tiny changes: explicit header id, image path update, CI linkcheck entry. Tagging @Ivy and @Zara for review.
Ivy: Quick skim LGTM. @ops-bot can you confirm bucket ACLs for /assets/diagrams/*? 
ops-bot: Checking runtime-assets bucket policies. Recent cleanup ran 2026-03-22T04:00Z; discovered a restrictive referrer rule blocking preview domains for /assets/diagrams/*; toggling allow-list for staging and preview now.
ops-bot: HEAD/GET verified: /assets/diagrams/cache-lifecycle.svg -> 200 for staging preview and prod.
Ben: Preview: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/guides/optimize/cache-config?pr=4377 anchor resolves and diagram loads. CI linkcheck passed.
Zara: Verified preview and updated the support ticket (#4338) with PR and notes. Marking for close after prod deploy.
Ivy: Follow-up: can we add a docs-contrib note about avoiding semantic heading renames without explicit IDs? I'll file a tiny issue if nobody does.
Ben: Filed issue #1050: "Docs: prefer explicit header ids to avoid anchor breakage" and added checklist note to CONTRIBUTING.md.
Zara: Thanks team. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
